units.source_text: 我屏住气息看她的脸看得出神。

en.t: I held my breath and gazed at her face, completely entranced.

units.source_text: 这张脸无论对未来还是对过去都搭不上一句话。

en.t: That face could not be connected by a single word either to the future or to the past.

units.source_text: 我们在刚砍伐的树墩上曾经见过这张不可思议的脸。

en.t: We had once seen that mysterious face on the stump of a freshly felled tree.

units.source_text: 尽管这张不可思议的脸带着新鲜而娇嫩的色泽，但是成长在那里已经停止。

en.t: Although that mysterious face bore a fresh and delicate color, its growth had already stopped there.

units.source_text: 那沐浴着不该沐浴的风和日光，突然被暴露在本不属于自己的世界的横断面上，画出了美丽的木纹。

en.t: Bathed in wind and sunlight it should never have received, suddenly exposed on a cross section in a world that was not its own, it traced beautiful wood grain.

units.source_text: 这张脸是只因为拒绝而被暴露到这个世界上来的……

en.t: This face had been exposed to the world solely because of refusal...
